execute.description: Derive a unique slug per story from its title
execute.sql:
UPDATE content."story" AS s
                     SET "slug" = candidate.slug
                    FROM (
                          SELECT id,
                                 base || CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN '' ELSE '-' || rn::text END AS slug
                            FROM (
                                  SELECT id,
                                         base,
                                         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY base ORDER BY "createdAt", id) AS rn
                                    FROM (
                                          SELECT id,
                                                 "createdAt",
                                                 COALESCE(
                                                   NULLIF(
                                                     trim(BOTH '-' FROM regexp_replace(lower(title), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g')),
                                                     ''
                                                   ),
                                                   'story'
                                                 ) AS base
                                            FROM content."story"
                                           WHERE "slug" IS NULL
                                         ) AS slugged
                                 ) AS numbered
                         ) AS candidate
                   WHERE s.id = candidate.id
                     AND s."slug" IS NULL
